ingredients.notes:

then strained. It keeps for months and tolerates high heat.

ingredients.name: Gram flour
ingredients.notes:
Flour ground from split brown chickpeas (chana dal). It has no gluten and
tastes raw until it is cooked through, so fry or toast it slowly. A cup
weighs about 90 g, much less than a cup of wheat flour.
